check_version.description: Find out whether a version of a product is still supported and until when: its end-of-life date, the days left, the phase it is in, the newest version to update to, and whether a newer release cycle is out. Takes an exact version (3.12.4) or a release cycle (3.12).

release_cycle.summary: Python 3.12 is supported until 2028-10-31 (743 days left); active support ended on 2025-04-02.

mock_response.summary: Python 3.12.4, in release cycle 3.12, is supported until 2028-10-31 (743 days left); active support ended on 2025-04-02. 3.12.15 is the newest 3.12 release. The newest release cycle is 3.15, at version 3.15.0.

description: Check whether the versions you run are still supported and until when, for about 500 programming languages, frameworks, databases, operating systems, cloud services and devices. See what reaches end of life soon, what was just released, and which product a package belongs to, and start workflows on new releases and approaching end-of-life dates. No account or API key required.
